outcome: moment of referral from primary to secondary care
cohort: Pregnant women in the Netherlands whose pregnancies started in 2018
finding: Living in a deprived neighborhood is associated with more intensive maternal care (earlier referral to secondary care, higher odds of cesarean section) and higher maternal care costs in the Netherlands.
mod_finding: Women in deprived neighborhoods had lower odds of assisted delivery than women in non-deprived neighborhoods, and they had higher odds of a cesarean section.
